title: Analytic guiding center formulas for bounce-transit motion in a concentric circular, finite inverse aspect ratio tokamak geometry
abstract: Bounce-transit motion in concentric circular magnetic geometry is typically analyzed in the limit that the inverse aspect ratio, $\varepsilon$, is small. We prove that this approximation is not necessary to study a concentric circular geometry by deriving new analytical formulas while retaining a non-zero $\varepsilon.$ We use these formulas to demonstrate that the approximation is robust for $\varepsilon \lesssim 0.3.$
